title: Multiple Choice - Closest in Meaning
description: Choose the word or phrase CLOSEST in meaning to the underlined part.

questions.text: The hotel chain replaced plastic guest amenities with [eco-friendly] alternatives made from wheat straw.
The floodwaters left the village well [contaminated] with untreated industrial chemicals and sewage.
Fallen autumn leaves slowly [decompose] in the forest, returning organic nutrients to the woodland soil.
Urban planners are developing [sustainable] communities that rely on renewable solar power and green spaces.
Households are encouraged to [reduce] their power consumption during peak afternoon hours.
